name: Portal P-004 deployed probe non-mutation and detector control
command: npx tsx scripts/perf-probe.mts --tabs home,brainstorm --mode warm --repeats 1 --out /tmp/p004-nonmutation-probe.json --label p004-nonmutation-focus
GET http://127.0.0.1:3081/api/preferences -> canonical after snapshot; compare full preferences
mutate an in-memory copy by appending __positive_control_mutant__ to pinnedApps; require comparator mismatch
summary: A focused current-head deployed warm probe drove one rail destination and one More-panel destination without changing any preference field; an isolated pinnedApps mutant proved the equality detector can turn red. This did not rerun the completed 34-tab performance measurement.

assertions.evidence: The probe artifact records baseUrl http://127.0.0.1:3081, mode warm, two samples, duration 19 seconds, and host load 141.13 to 131.3.
home and brainstorm each produced one content sample; brainstorm exercised the More-panel path, and skipped was empty.
Canonical full preferences JSON before and after had the same SHA-256: 28c9322c7449509e403e0074790f06c2a25003bc568295e791970c65cf3f1230.
Appending __positive_control_mutant__ to pinnedApps in an isolated copy produced a comparator mismatch, proving the detector notices the D-004 mutation class.
The generated focused probe artifact SHA-256 was cc1254ddac2984db81710541547b2c5e0f60660fa4a9039dd388bf4fa6f89e3d.
